thread.title: Dow Soars 470 Points As Apple, Microsoft Lead Stock Market Rally - Investor's Business Daily

title: Dow Soars 470 Points As Apple, Microsoft Lead Stock Market Rally - Investor's Business Daily
text:
Techs bounced back big time as stocks extended their gains in afternoon trading Thursday, boosting the major market indexes to session highs.
X The Nasdaq led with a 3.5% surge as technology stocks rebounded from sharp losses. The S&P 500 rallied 2.4% and the Dow Jones industrial average leapt 1.9%. Small caps took part in the bounce, with the Russell 2000 up 2.4%. Volume was running higher on both the NYSE and Nasdaq, a bullish sign.
Yet, with the Nasdaq, S&P 500 and Dow still 9%, 7% and 7% off their respective highs, the stock market has plenty of ground to make up. All three indexes are still below their 200-day moving averages. But it's a good time for investors to refresh their watch lists and keep a close eye on leading stocks.
Microsoft ( MSFT ) and Intel ( INTC ) led the Dow with gains north of 5% each. Microsoft recovered nearly all its losses from the prior session, when shares tumbled close to the 200-day line. Late Wednesday, the software giant delivered a quarterly sales and earnings beat , thanks to growth in its cloud computing services.
Intel, which has been in a downtrend since early June, recouped its 4.7% Wednesday loss. The chipmaker is 22% off its high and below its 50-day and 200-day lines. The chipmaker group has gotten hammered the past few months. It ranked No. 168 (as of Wednesday's close) out of IBD's 197 industry groups.
Big-Cap Tech Rally Other blue chip techs scoring big gains included Cisco ( CSCO ) and Apple ( AAPL ), up 3.8% and 2.7%, respectively. Cisco has been finding support along its 200-day line, while Apple has been hugging its 50-day line.
At just 5% off its high, Apple has held up remarkably well during the correction. It could offer a buy opportunity on a strong bounce off the line, or may continue consolidating in a new base. Bernstein on Wednesday hiked its Apple price target to 225 from 200, citing rising average selling prices for the iPhone and Apple Watch.
Automakers, internet retail and gaming software were among the top sector gainers in the stock market today. Gold miners, utilities and food stocks lagged.
Tesla ( TSLA ) led automakers with an 8% jump to retake its 200-day moving average. It rose as much as 11% in early trade. After the close Wednesday, the electric-auto maker reported Q3 results that beat views on both the top and bottom lines. Adjusted earnings per share of $2.90 crushed forecasts for a 19-cent loss. At 19% off its high, the stock has plenty of ground to make up.

Only three of the IBD 50 stocks showed small losses with an hour left to go in the session. Biggest gainers included Tractor Supply ( TSCO ), PRA Health Sciences ( PRAH ) and Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ), up more than 5% apiece. Netflix ( NFLX ) and PayPal ( PYPL ) contributed gains of nearly 4% each.
The Innovator IBD 50 ETF ( FFTY ) rose 2%. On Wednesday, it tumbled nearly 5%.
